ModMetaData.name: Witcher Potions
ModMetaData.author: Tristan
ModMetaData.description:
Forage wild witcher herbs and brew alchemical draughts at a campfire or drug lab — healing swallow, combat thunderbolt, detox white honey, and more.
These brews are toxic to ordinary humans. Only those with strong natural or mutagenic resistance to poison can drink them safely — witchers among them.
